title: DeepSeek Harness launches modular AI coding tool with 28K stars #DeepSeek #opensourceai #aicoding
description: DeepSeek launched DeepSeek Harness, a modular AI coding agent that reached 28,000 GitHub stars in one day. It offers unparalleled customization with an everything-is-a-plugin design, allowing users to swap models, tools, UI, and workflows effortlessly. The platform integrates 53 built-in tools and a local web UI that activates with a single command. Notably, Harness can incorporate popular AI models like Claude Code and Codex as sub-agents, creating cost-effective, hybrid workflows. DeepSeek Harness signals a shift toward commoditization in AI-assisted coding, providing developers a free, flexible blueprint for customizing and optimizing programming agents across use cases. #DeepSeek #DeepSeekHarness #ClaudeCode #Codex #AICodingAgent #ModularAI #AIWorkflow #OpenSourceAI #CodingAutomation #DeveloperTools #AICommoditization #GitHubStar #AIIntegration #MachineLearning #AIDevtools
